title: pastatemp: Paired Air and Stream Temperature Analysis (PASTA) at the annual and diel scales
description: Python package and Streamlit app for paired air and stream temperature analysis (PASTA). Reads logger files, sorts air and stream loggers, pairs them by name (data as a last resort), and fits annual and diel sinusoids to report amplitude ratio, phase lag, mean ratio and thermal sensitivity. A Python port of the PASTA and Diel PASTA R code.
